title: Decraft Blocks by Juix
description: Datapack that lets you uncraft blocks made from 4 items, like Quartz or Sandstone
body:
# ℹ️ Decraft Blocks By Juix The Decraft Blocks pack will add new recipes to your game, in order to let you uncraft 2x2 blocks (made from 4 items) (wool, bricks, sandstone, quartz...) into items, like 3x3 blocks (iron, slime, honey...).
This pack is compatible with mods like JEI or REI.

![Example](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ed35d56d43fec353b3863eca1366b13276fa3632_0.webp)
# ⚒️ Recipes Please go to the Gallery page to explore all of them
